PZZ700-081000-
208 PM PDT Wed Oct 7 2026

.Synopsis for the far Southern CA coast...
At 2 PM, a 1022 mb high was about 400 nautical miles west of Cape
Blanco, Oregon, a 1007 mb low was over extreme southern 
California. A 984 mb low was at the core of Hurricane Rachel about
900 nautical miles south of Point Conception. Weak offshore flow 
near shore during the mornings and weak onshore northwest flow 
during the afternoons will prevail through Thursday. Gusty winds 
and choppy seas are expected Sunday into early next week. Please 
stay tuned for more details in the coming days. 

$$
